page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t6-c4m1.large is a shared burstable virtual instance designed for low-resource utility workloads. Powered by the KVM hypervisor on the x86_64 architecture, the instance provides 2 burstable vCPUs backed by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. Memory capacity is constrained to 0.5 GB total, representing a resource ratio of 0.25 GB RAM per vCPU.

The hardware configuration includes no integrated local storage and no dedicated hardware accelerators or GPUs. Network throughput is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 0 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default. Virtual CPU compute capacity operates under a shared burstable credit model, restricting sustained peak processor usage.

Due to the low 0.5 GB memory footprint and burstable CPU scheduling, this instance offers high cost efficiency for lightweight tasks that do not demand persistent compute or expansive memory buffers. The primary operational tradeoff is the severe constraint on both system memory and sustained multi-core processing throughput.

Alibaba Cloud ecs.t6-c4m1.large is best suited for minimal background processes, basic automation scripts, network health checks, low-load utility daemons, and development or testing environments requiring minimal operating system memory overhead.
